lpHeroLead: For rural workers: no middlemen, no trips to the government office. See your job card status, the days you have worked, and the wage coming straight to your bank account.
lpTrustCaption: A transparent, free public-rights service in the language of your village

lpCompareTitle: The government portal versus Mera Rozgar
lpCompareLead: We removed the technical barriers and put control of their own entitlement into every rural worker's hands.
lpOld1Body: Cryptic codes, unreadable tables and a pile of English words that nobody can get through without a computer operator.
lpOld2Body: To find out how many days were recorded on your job card, you have to keep going back to the panchayat secretary or the rozgar sevak.
lpOld3Body: If the money is stuck, why is it stuck? Was the FTO rejected, or is PFMS holding it? You never get a clear answer.
lpOldFooter: The result: workers who are legally entitled go without their earnings simply because nobody told them anything.
lpNew1Title: Plain local language, and a voice option
lpNew1Body: Understand it directly in your own tongue. An audio assistant reads it aloud for workers who cannot read easily.
lpNew2Title: Your passbook, on your own phone
lpNew2Body: Which field or drain you worked on, on which day, and the wage it earned — every single day of it, itemised.
lpNew3Title: A clear reason for a delay, and a direct complaint
lpNew3Body: If the wage has not arrived for more than 15 days, find out why at once and file a free complaint.
lpNewFooter: The result: a life with dignity, the full amount, and complete freedom from middlemen.
lpHowLead: Three straight steps to put the account of your own entitlement into your hands.
lpStep1Title: Enter your number or job card
lpStep1Body: Fill in your job card number or the mobile number linked to your bank. No complicated form and no documents needed.
lpStep2Title: See the work and the wage owed
lpStep2Body: In a clear chart and calendar, see how many days were recorded, how much reached the bank, and which instalment is still pending.
lpStep3Title: If the money is stuck, speak up
lpStep3Body: If the wage has not arrived for more than 15 days, file a complaint in one click, straight to the district ombudsman or the toll-free helpline.
lpQuote: Earlier, when the wage did not come, the pradhan would say the server was down. Now we look at our own phone and see the date our money reached the bank. We do not need to hold out our hands to anyone.
lpCtaPill: Knowing your rights is standing on your own feet
